title: Docker Hub OAuth access token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 9 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 26-byte dckr_oat_ body vs the exact 27 Docker's Hub API example shows, length: 28-byte dckr_oat_ body vs the exact 27 Docker's Hub API example shows (and not the tool-corroborated 32), and length: 40 vs contracted 41. Twin of "Docker Hub OAuth access token and Docker Hub Personal access token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of docker-token-oat-27-bare: length: 26-byte dckr_oat_ body vs the exact 27 Docker's Hub API example shows. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
